title: Active learning designs selective growth media for six bacteria
summary: A sequential active learning framework with multi-objective gradient-boosting decision tree models predicted formulations from 30 common components that maximize target bacterial growth and minimize non-target growth, for six phylogenetically diverse bacteria. Iterative cycles of prediction and high-throughput growth assays refined the media, which enhanced target growth and selectivity, and coculture experiments confirmed promotion of specific bacteria within communities. The abstract gives no numeric gains.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosting decision trees with multi-objective sequential active learning

evidence.tested: Iterative wet-lab growth assays and coculture confirmation of predicted media.
evidence.unknown: Size of the improvements and generalization to other bacteria and communities; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning proposed media formulations that were tested and fed back in cycles.
